title: Minimal Inversions in Integer Matrices of Fixed RSK Shape
summary: The Robinson-Schensted-Knuth (RSK) algorithm maps an integer matrix to a pair of semi-standard Young tableaux (SSYTs) whose underlying shape has the same integer partition. We study the set of matrices associated with a given partition $λ$ vis-a-vis the number of inversions of the matrix. In the case where the integer matrix is a permutation matrix, the resulting tableaux are standard Young tableaux or SYTs. Han (EJC, 2005) combinatorially studied the set of permutations that map to SYTs of shape $λ$ under the RSK algorithm and counted the permutations with the minimum number of inversions…
